title: lp-ip.evaluate/1 payload
description: Check given points against one lp-ip.model/1 artifact without solving; one task per point.
$comment: Rules outside this schema: the job has exactly one input, its name equals model_input, it holds an lp-ip.model/1 artifact and its sha256 matches. resources.inner_threads must be 1. Points are inline: keep the job well below the runner's 4 MiB validation output.

model_input.description: Name of the job input that holds the model.

points.description: Points to check, one task each; they may violate bounds.
points.$comment: Every point needs exactly n entries (n = length of the model's objective).

feasibility_tolerance.description: Absolute bound and row violation accepted, in original units.
